_comment: Boss loot (design/gdd/boss-loot.md, Boss 2026-11-16), read by logic/boss_loot.gd. One entry per zone boss (key = data/world/zones.json zone id). On a WON run of the zone's journey (server, Journey.pay_card_xp) each account gets: coins_per_kill of `coin` (a camp.json material, never scaled); a `piece_chance` chance of one random piece of `set` (uniform over the set's catalog items), its tier rolled from data/loot/loot.json tier_weights at the boss's level (the journey's last stage, enemy with boss: true); a `relic_chance` chance of one `relic` (a camp.json material). Both chances x that player's loot_by_squad factor. first_kill_min_tier: the account's first win (before unlocks.boss_<zone> is set) guarantees one piece of at least this tier (rerolled tier below it is raised to it); it replaces that run's piece roll. price_coins: the shop price of each set piece in this boss's coin. shop_tier_weights (Boss 2026-11-16): relative weights over rules.json tiers [normal, rare, epic, legendary] for the tier a BOUGHT piece rolls (server rng, one draw). PLACEHOLDER numbers (25% / 1% / 500 are the GDD's; the 500-coin farm time is flagged for a Boss check in GDD 3).
